work_items.title: Add reusable GitHub repo deployment method
acceptance_criteria: Skill includes a reusable method for a user to point Codex at a GitHub URL or local repo path.
Deployment method creates project-specific workflow, state, progress, backoff, scheduled plan, and automation.
Default deployment safety forbids push, PR, deploy, production config changes, external trackers, and user-work reverts.
Validation records target path, remote identity, automation id, first queued item, and blockers.
implementation_notes: Added in response to Bill's requirement that Lambchop be applicable to another GitHub repo as a full project-specific autonomous coding team.
